meta.title: GridWise TITAN-20 — 20 Extreme Adversarial System Breakers
meta.description: 20 ultra-adversarial scenarios engineered to be 10x harder than Killer-10. Targets: semantic retractions, archaic Sadhu/Sylheti dialects, MW-to-kWh unit conversions, counterfactuals, double negations, fractional math, razor-thin LP feasibility boundaries, and multi-note interlocking constraints.

titan_tests.title: The Intra-Note Retraction & Substitution Trap
titan_tests.attack_vector: Explicit retraction within a single note: 'scratch that earlier plan' + valid alternative directive
titan_tests.description: The note initially mentions capping grid import at 60 kWh from 7 PM to 10 PM (which would cause severe infeasibility), but explicitly cancels it mid-sentence ('scratch that plan completely; disregard it'). It then introduces a valid solar cleaning directive for 11 AM to 2 PM reducing generation by three quarters (factor=0.25). The LLM must not extract the retracted grid cap.
operator_notes: We initially planned to cap grid import at 60 units from 7 PM to 10 PM, but scratch that plan completely and disregard it; however, the rooftop solar array wash from 11 AM to 2 PM is confirmed and will reduce generation by three quarters.

expected_directives.explanation: Solar reduction of 75% (factor 0.25) from 11 AM to 2 PM. The retracted grid cap must be ignored.

titan_tests.title: Engineering Unit Conversion: Megawatts (MW) to kWh
titan_tests.attack_vector: Industrial power units (MW) requiring mathematical conversion to hourly energy (kWh)
titan_tests.description: The note specifies a grid import limit in Megawatts: '0.09 MW'. In a 1-hour interval, 0.09 MW = 90 kW = 90 kWh. Naive LLMs copy 0.09 (which chokes the optimizer with near-zero grid) or 90000. It must convert 0.09 MW -> 90 kWh.
operator_notes: Due to substation 33kV busbar thermal stress, grid intake cannot exceed 0.09 MW in any hour between 18:00 and 22:00.

expected_directives.explanation: 0.09 MW equals 90 kWh per hour from 6 PM to 10 PM.

titan_tests.title: Classical Sadhu Bhasha (সাধু ভাষা) Archaic Bengali Directive
titan_tests.attack_vector: 19th century archaic literary Bengali (Sadhu Bhasha) syntax and vocabulary
titan_tests.description: Uses archaic high-register Sanskritized Bengali: 'অদ্য অপরাহ্ন দ্বি-ঘটিকায় সৌর প্যানেলসমূহের সংযোগ বিচ্ছিন্নকরণপূর্বক অপরাহ্ন পঞ্চ-ঘটিকা পর্যন্ত সৌর বিদ্যুৎ উৎপাদন সম্পূর্ণরূপে স্থগিত থাকিবে।' (Today at 2 PM disconnecting solar panels until 5 PM, solar generation will remain completely suspended).
operator_notes: অদ্য অপরাহ্ন দ্বি-ঘটিকায় সৌর প্যানেলসমূহের সংযোগ বিচ্ছিন্নকরণপূর্বক অপরাহ্ন পঞ্চ-ঘটিকা পর্যন্ত সৌর বিদ্যুৎ উৎপাদন সম্পূর্ণরূপে স্থগিত থাকিবে।

expected_directives.explanation: 2 PM to 5 PM (hours 14, 15, 16) complete solar shutdown (factor 0.0).

titan_tests.title: The Multi-Tier Fraction & Ratio Array Failure Trap
titan_tests.attack_vector: Compound fractional loss: Sub-array trip (3/5) + partial derating of remainder
titan_tests.description: 3/5 of the solar array trips completely (yields 0). The remaining 2/5 of the array runs at half capacity (50%). Total remaining generation factor = (2/5) * 0.50 = 0.20 (20% of nominal). Hours: 1 PM to 4 PM (hours [13, 14, 15]).
operator_notes: Inverter cluster A (three-fifths of our total rooftop capacity) will be offline from 1 PM to 4 PM, and the surviving two-fifths of panels will operate at only 50% efficiency during that time.

expected_directives.explanation: Remaining capacity is 2/5 * 50% = 20% (factor 0.20) for hours 13, 14, 15.

titan_tests.title: The Counterfactual Past Subjunctive Trap ('Had it not been for...')
titan_tests.attack_vector: Grammatically counterfactual conditional expressing an action that was NOT taken
titan_tests.description: The note states: 'Had the storm warning escalated we would have locked battery reserve at 95% from 6 PM to midnight, but with the alert canceled, standard dispatch rules apply.' This is a classic false-positive lure. The directive was never activated. Expected: no_op.
operator_notes: Had the coastal depression escalated into a cyclone we would have locked battery reserve at 95% from 6 PM to midnight, but with the alert canceled, normal dispatch schedule remains in force.

expected_directives.explanation: Counterfactual statement describing a canceled contingency plan. No operational change.

titan_tests.title: Sylheti Dialect Phonetic Directives (সিলেটি চল)
titan_tests.attack_vector: Sylheti regional spoken dialect written in Bengali script with localized idioms
titan_tests.description: 'আইজকা রাইত বারোটা থাইকা বিয়ান পাঁচটা তক ব্যাটারি থনে কুনু কারেন্ট বাইর করন যাইতো নায়, পুরাপুরি বন্ধ রাখবা।' (Today from 12 midnight to 5 morning, no current can be taken out from battery, keep completely closed). Maps to no_discharge_window from 00:00 to 05:00 (hours [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]).
operator_notes: আইজকা রাইত বারোটা থাইকা বিয়ান পাঁচটা তক ব্যাটারি থনে কুনু কারেন্ট বাইর করন যাইতো নায়, পুরাপুরি বন্ধ রাখবা।

expected_directives.explanation: No battery discharge from midnight (12 AM) to 5 AM.

titan_tests.title: Inter-Note Nullification & Redirection Across Notes 0 and 1
titan_tests.attack_vector: Note 1 explicitly rescinds and replaces Note 0
titan_tests.description: Note 0 requests a complete halt on battery charging between 14:00 and 18:00. Note 1 states: 'Superintendent override: Cancel Note 0's charging ban; instead, enforce a minimum 160 kWh reserve during those same afternoon hours.' Note 0 becomes no_op (or superseded), Note 1 is minimum_battery_reserve of 160 kWh.
operator_notes: Prohibit all battery charging from 2 PM to 6 PM for cell temperature monitoring.
Superintendent override regarding the previous note: cancel the charging ban completely; instead, maintain at least 160 kWh battery reserve during those exact same afternoon hours (2 PM to 6 PM).

expected_directives.explanation: Overridden and canceled by Note 1.
Maintains 160 kWh reserve between 2 PM and 6 PM.

titan_tests.title: Relative Astronomical Time Reference (Solar Noon Offset)
titan_tests.attack_vector: Time defined relative to 'solar noon' (12:00) with backward and forward duration offsets
titan_tests.description: 'Beginning two hours prior to solar noon and enduring for a total duration of five hours, dust deposition will restrict solar yield to roughly one-fourth.' Solar noon = 12:00. 2 hours prior = 10:00. Duration 5 hours = 10:00 to 15:00 (hours [10, 11, 12, 13, 14]). Factor = 0.25.
operator_notes: Beginning two hours prior to solar noon (12:00) and enduring for a total duration of five hours, atmospheric dust deposition will restrict solar yield to roughly one-fourth.

expected_directives.explanation: 10 AM to 3 PM (5 hours starting 2 hours before 12:00), factor 0.25.

titan_tests.title: Reversed Temporal Phrasing ('End-before-Start') Syntax
titan_tests.attack_vector: Sentence structure places the termination timestamp before the commencement timestamp
titan_tests.description: 'Until 6 AM counting backwards from 1 AM, the battery must remain strictly on idle or discharge only, completely barring any charging.' End is 6 AM, start is 1 AM. Target hours are 1 AM to 6 AM (hours [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]). Directive: no_charge_window.
operator_notes: Until 6 AM starting from 1 AM, the battery must remain strictly on idle or discharge, completely barring any charging.

expected_directives.explanation: No charging between 1 AM and 6 AM.

titan_tests.title: Industrial Microgrid Distractor (HVAC + Chiller + Diesel RPM)
titan_tests.attack_vector: High-density technical power engineering jargon that does NOT map to microgrid schedule directives
titan_tests.description: Mentions chillers, cooling tons, diesel generator synchronization at 1500 RPM, power factor 0.85 lagging, and harmonic distortion between 14:00 and 17:00. Sounds intensely actionable to naive LLMs, but is completely outside the microgrid LP formulation. Expected: no_op.
operator_notes: Centrifugal Chiller #2 requires 250 tons of refrigeration and the emergency backup diesel generator will synchronize at 1500 RPM with 0.85 lagging power factor between 2 PM and 5 PM for harmonic mitigation.

expected_directives.explanation: Internal mechanical HVAC and diesel generator synchronization note with no microgrid dispatch directives.

titan_tests.title: Midnight Wrap with Negative Delta Phrasing ('3h before midnight to 2h after')
titan_tests.attack_vector: Time span defined as negative/positive offsets across the day boundary
titan_tests.description: 'Prevent battery charging starting three hours before midnight until two hours after midnight.' 3h before midnight = 21:00 (9 PM). 2h after midnight = 02:00 (2 AM). Window spans: 21, 22, 23, 0, 1. Must be returned in strictly sorted ascending order: [0, 1, 21, 22, 23].
operator_notes: Prevent battery charging starting three hours before midnight until two hours after midnight for firmware recalibration.

expected_directives.explanation: No charge from 21:00 to 02:00, sorted as [0, 1, 21, 22, 23].

titan_tests.title: The Razor's Edge: Exact Mathematical Feasibility Boundary
titan_tests.attack_vector: Tightest possible constraint boundary: Demand (180) == Max Grid (100) + Max Battery Discharge (80)
titan_tests.description: At peak hour 19, demand is 180 kWh, solar is 0, battery max discharge is 80 kWh. Grid cap is set to exactly 100 kWh. 100 + 80 = 180 kWh exactly! Any numerical drift or premature rounding in the LP will cause false infeasibility.
operator_notes: National grid transmission corridor congestion: grid intake must not exceed 100 kWh per hour between 7 PM and 9 PM.

expected_directives.explanation: Grid capped at 100 kWh during hours 19 and 20.

titan_tests.title: Complementary Percentage Contrast ('30% Loss' vs 'at 30% of Normal')
titan_tests.attack_vector: Two contradictory percentage representations in the same context
titan_tests.description: Note specifies: 'Morning fog will cause a 30% reduction in solar output from 8 AM to 11 AM, whereas midday dust means solar will operate AT 30% of normal capacity from 11 AM to 2 PM.' Note 0 must have factor=0.70 (1.0 - 0.30) for hours [8, 9, 10]. Note 1 must have factor=0.30 for hours [11, 12, 13].
operator_notes: Morning fog will cause a 30% reduction in solar output from 8 AM to 11 AM.
Midday dust buildup means solar will operate at only 30% of nominal capacity from 11 AM to 2 PM.

expected_directives.explanation: 30% reduction = 70% remaining (factor 0.70) from 8 AM to 11 AM.
Operate AT 30% = 30% remaining (factor 0.30) from 11 AM to 2 PM.

titan_tests.title: C-Rate Thermal Protection Phrased as Reserve Percentage
titan_tests.attack_vector: Vulgar fractions ('three-quarters of total capacity') computed against battery capacity
titan_tests.description: 'To preserve battery electrolyte stability under extreme heat, maintain at least three-quarters of total battery capacity in reserve between 12:00 and 16:00.' Battery capacity is 400 kWh. Three-quarters (3/4 = 0.75) * 400 = 300 kWh. Hours: [12, 13, 14, 15].
operator_notes: To preserve battery electrolyte stability under ambient heat, maintain at least three-quarters of total battery capacity as reserve between 12:00 and 16:00.

expected_directives.explanation: 3/4 of 400 kWh capacity = 300 kWh reserve for hours 12, 13, 14, 15.

titan_tests.title: Single-Hour Boundary Transition at Midnight (Hour 23 Exactly)
titan_tests.attack_vector: Boundary expression that maps to a single final hour of the optimization day
titan_tests.description: 'From 23:00 to 00:00, battery must not discharge under any circumstance.' The interval [23, 24) maps strictly to hour 23. It must not spill into hour 0 of the next day or empty the list.
operator_notes: From 23:00 to 00:00 midnight, the battery must not discharge under any circumstance.

expected_directives.explanation: Strictly hour 23 (11 PM to midnight).

titan_tests.title: Mixed Code-Switching with Parenthetical Legal/Bureaucratic Noise
titan_tests.attack_vector: Code-switching surrounded by heavy bureaucratic and regulatory boilerplate
titan_tests.description: 'Transformer safety hazard er karone shokal 8ta theke dupur 12ta porjonto grid theke সর্বোচ্চ 110 unit er beshi ana jabe na (Ref: BPDB Safety Circular 2026/04-B, mandatory compliance for all BUP campus substations).' Must extract max_grid_window 110 kWh for hours [8, 9, 10, 11] without getting tripped by reference numbers or bureaucratic text.
operator_notes: Transformer safety hazard er karone shokal 8ta theke dupur 12ta porjonto grid theke সর্বোচ্চ 110 unit er beshi ana jabe na (Ref: BPDB Safety Circular 2026/04-B, mandatory compliance for all campus substations).

expected_directives.explanation: 8 AM to 12 PM (hours 8, 9, 10, 11) grid cap of 110 kWh.

titan_tests.title: Corporate PR Announcement vs Actionable Grid Policy Blend
titan_tests.attack_vector: 3 notes: Two corporate sustainability PR notices sandwiching a real operational grid cap
titan_tests.description: Note 0: Vice Chancellor signs Net Zero Charter (no_op). Note 1: Grid draw must stay below 95 kWh from 5 PM to 9 PM (max_grid_window). Note 2: Auditorium hosts sustainability gala at 3 PM (no_op).
operator_notes: The Vice Chancellor officially ratified the BUP Green Campus 2030 Sustainability Charter this morning.
Under the charter interim protocol, grid draw must stay below 95 kWh between 5 PM and 9 PM today.
The annual sustainability gala and prize distribution will take place in the central auditorium at 3 PM.

expected_directives.explanation: PR announcement of sustainability charter ratification.
Grid capped at 95 kWh from 5 PM to 9 PM.
Announcement regarding auditorium gala event.

titan_tests.title: Chittagonian Regional Dialect (চাটগাঁইয়া বুলি)
titan_tests.attack_vector: Chittagonian regional dialect phonology and vocabulary
titan_tests.description: 'আইজ্জা দুপুর বারোটা তন তিনটা পয্যন্ত সোলার প্যানেল ধোয়াই চলিবু, এনদে বিদ্যুৎ উৎপাদন আড়াই আনা (২৫%) অইবো।' (Today from 12 noon to 3 PM solar panel washing will go on, production will be 25%). Hours [12, 13, 14], factor 0.25.
operator_notes: আইজ্জা দুপুর বারোটা তন তিনটা পয্যন্ত সোলার প্যানেল ধোয়াই চলিবু, এনদে বিদ্যুৎ উৎপাদন ২৫% অইবো।

expected_directives.explanation: 12 PM to 3 PM (hours 12, 13, 14) solar reduction to 25% (factor 0.25).

titan_tests.title: Extreme Multi-Hour Disjoint Range in Banglish
titan_tests.attack_vector: Single note imposing non-contiguous multi-window charging restrictions
titan_tests.description: 'Shokal 6ta theke 8ta ebong abar bikal 4ta theke 6ta porjonto battery charge kora ekdom bondho thakbe.' Two windows: 6 AM to 8 AM ([6, 7]) and 4 PM to 6 PM ([16, 17]). Combined sorted hours: [6, 7, 16, 17].
operator_notes: Shokal 6ta theke 8ta ebong abar bikal 4ta theke 6ta porjonto battery charge kora ekdom bondho thakbe.

expected_directives.explanation: No charge during two separate intervals: 6-8 AM and 4-6 PM.

titan_tests.title: The Grand Interlocking Tri-Directive Harmony Puzzle
titan_tests.attack_vector: Three interlocking, non-conflicting directives that test simultaneous multi-window scheduling
titan_tests.description: Note 0: Solar cleaning 11 AM to 2 PM, drop to 30% (factor=0.30, hours [11, 12, 13]). Note 1: No battery discharge 2 PM to 6 PM (hours [14, 15, 16, 17]). Note 2: Grid cap 120 kWh from 6 PM to 10 PM (hours [18, 19, 20, 21]). Designed with calibrated demand so the LP solves smoothly with zero constraint collisions.
operator_notes: Rooftop solar maintenance will lower generation to 30% from 11 AM to 2 PM.
Preserve stored energy for the evening peak: no battery discharge allowed between 2 PM and 6 PM.
National grid sub-station advisory: cap grid import at 120 kWh per hour from 6 PM to 10 PM.

expected_directives.explanation: Solar down to 30% (factor 0.30) from 11 AM to 2 PM.
No discharge from 2 PM to 6 PM.
Max grid 120 kWh from 6 PM to 10 PM.
